key_insight: Axiomatic Learning Structures (ALS) and Axiomatic Probabilistic Structures (APS) connect learning and probability methods to the axioms governing mathematical objects and transformations.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support structure-aware recovery from noisy mathematical data and task-specific selection of transformations.
method: Relate loss functions and probabilistic models to the axioms of their underlying objects and transformations.
Use Transformations-Axiomatic Based Learning (TABLe) to rank candidate transformations by task-specific scores.
Explore integer-polynomial recovery using standard derivatives and arithmetic p-derivations, alongside noisy derivation equations.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes mathematical applications to polynomial recovery and noisy derivation equations, but reports no dataset sizes, benchmark comparisons, or quantitative results.
watch_item: Practical scalability and the reliability of transformation-ranking scores remain unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: Axiomatic Learning and Probabilistic Structures with first applications to variants of Arithmetic Machine Learning and beyond
